rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who speaks fluently, clearly, and well.

example.english: They are eloquent and explain everything clearly.
example.traditional: 佢口才好，無論講乜嘢都講得清清楚楚。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hau2 coi4 hou2 mou4 leon6 gong2 mat1 je5 dou1 gong2 dak1 cing1 cing1 co2 co2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on expressing meaning effectively and clearly rather than on persuasive force.

example.english: Ming is eloquent and can explain even such a complicated idea clearly.
example.traditional: 阿明表達能力強，連咁複雜嘅意思都講得好明白。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 biu2 daat6 nang4 lik6 koeng4 lin4 gam3 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 ji3 si1 dou1 gong2 dak1 hou2 ming4 baak6

rows.note: Use this when the speaker's eloquence is especially persuasive or convincing.

example.english: They are eloquent and finally convinced everyone to support the plan.
example.traditional: 佢句句有說服力，終於說服大家支持個計劃。
example.jyutping: keoi5 geoi3 geoi3 jau5 seoi3 fuk6 lik6 zung1 jyu1 seoi3 fuk6 daai6 gaa1 zi1 ci4 go3 gai3 waak6
